_comment: Everything kodes::Config can read. The reader is deliberately small - four getters, a key test, and dotted paths - because a caller that needs more than this should be using kodes::Settings, or its own reader.
name: counterFlowFlame2D
_comment_numbers: getDouble accepts anything numeric, so a tolerance written 1 or 10 reads back as 1.0 and 10.0 rather than silently falling back to the default
_comment_types: asking for the wrong type is not an error - it returns the default, so a mistyped entry behaves like a missing one
